event.description: Share four query output rows across depth blocks
event.proposal: family: attention organization; current retained incumbent is 2739 parameters at 99.7000%, a +0.70 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family most recent accepted result: attempt-0070, sharing three 14-value query rows across depth at 2739 parameters and 99.70%; same-family most recent failed result: attempt-0067, sharing both head-local attention output maps across depth at 2732 parameters and 9.42%; prior attempts in this family: 17. Hypothesis: the three-row query tie remains above threshold, so share a fourth query row across both depth blocks while retaining 10 block-specific query rows, both MQA K/V maps, and all head-local output maps independent across depth. This removes one additional 14-value row for a target of 2725. It is more informative than a larger jump or a K/V tie because it continues the nearest ordered query-row interpolation and measures whether the 99.7% margin survives another minimal depth-sharing change. Keep d14/h2/L2 MQA, ff23 with one within-block tied hidden unit shared across blocks, rank8 positions, two final group scales, reversed operands, zero weight decay, mixed-digit curriculum, and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy at least 99% and strictly fewer parameters than the incumbent.
